verse.verse_3: when the oceans are gushed forth,
verse.verse_5: the soul shall know what it has done, the former and the latter.
verse.verse_6: O human! What has deceived you concerning your Generous Lord
verse.verse_7: who created you, formed you and proportioned you?
verse.verse_8: In whatever shape He will He could surely have fashioned you.
verse.verse_10: Yet over you there are watchers,
verse.verse_12: who know of all that you do.
verse.verse_13: Indeed, the righteous shall (live) in bliss.
verse.verse_14: But the wicked, indeed they shall be in the Fiery Furnace,
verse.verse_15: roasting in it on the Day of Recompense
verse.verse_16: and from it they shall never be absent.
verse.verse_17: What could let you know what the Day of Recompense is!
verse.verse_18: Again, what could let you know what the Day of Recompense is!
verse.verse_19: It is the Day when no soul can do a thing for another soul. That Day, the command belongs to Allah.
